acting_instructions: Use a pillowy, high, warm childlike voice with bubbly giggles, as soft and cuddly as a plush panda, radiating kindness and curiosity. Keep the pace slow-to-medium and sing-song, with rounded, gentle articulation and a faint smile always audible; avoid any sharpness, irony, or harsh edges. Sprinkle tiny delighted breaths, cozy hums of contentment, and brief giggle-bursts, as if taking small waddling steps through a wonder-filled world. In teaching moments, repeat simple phrases with playful emphasis and tender encouragement, making every line feel safe, cozy, and joyfully reassuring.
